newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Pilots warn Portugal's TAP airline of strike.
newsitem.headline: Pilots warn Portugal's TAP airline of strike.

text.p: Portugal's main pilots' union has told state carrier TAP-Air Portugal that it plans an indefinite strike, beginning later this month, an airline spokeswoman said Wednesday.

A TAP spokeswoman, who asked not to be identified, said the airline had received written notice July 15 of the planned strike beginning midnight Saturday if it did not comply with strict conditions on pilots' working hours.

A copy of the strike warning from the Civil Aviation Pilots' Union (SPAC), made available to Reuters, said the action was a protest of the "disorganization of pilot stopovers." SPAC represents all of TAP's 430 pilots.
One SPAC official, Angelo Felgueiras, blamed poor organisation of pilots' working hours and accused the airline of bad management.
Diario de Noticias newspaper reported Wednesday that the strike could lead to the cancellation of 15 percent of TAP's flights and could cost the airline $17.9 million in August.
